description: Implement ResendEmailSender for production email delivery — Replace LogEmailSender with a Resend-based implementation using github.com/resend/resend-go/v3. The EmailSender interface already exists in handlers_auth.go with SendVerificationEmail(to, token) and SendMagicLinkEmail(to, token). Create a new email/ package (similar to subtitler/specs/email.md) with: ResendEmailSender struct wrapping resend.Client, HTML+text email templates for verification and magic link emails, APP_URL-based link generation, graceful fallback to LogEmailSender when RESEND_API_KEY is not set. Update main.go to initialize ResendEmailSender when RESEND_API_KEY is present. Env vars: RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM (default noreply@peekaboo.pottingers.us), APP_URL. Reference: subtitler/specs/email.md for working Resend integration pattern.
done_when: 1) email/resend.go implements EmailSender interface using resend-go/v3 2) email/templates.go has HTML+text templates for verification and magic link emails 3) email/mock.go provides MockEmailSender for tests 4) main.go creates ResendEmailSender when RESEND_API_KEY is set, falls back to LogEmailSender 5) Verification email contains link to APP_URL/verify-email?token=X 6) Magic link email contains link to APP_URL/magic-link?token=X 7) go test ./email passes 8) go test ./api passes (existing auth tests unchanged) 9) Manual test: register account, receive real email via Resend

description:
Add feedback fetch pipeline — Create scripts/fetch-feedback.py and a GET /api/admin/feedback endpoint to enable Ralph to pull user feedback from production. Reference: subtitler/specs/feedback-fetch.md for the complete pattern.

Part 1 — Backend GET endpoint: Add GET /api/admin/feedback that returns feedback items as JSON. Requires authentication. Supports query params: status (new/reviewed/all, default new), limit (default 50), after (ISO timestamp cursor for pagination). Only accessible to users listed in TRUSTED_USERS env var (comma-separated user IDs). Returns 403 for unauthorized users. Register route in main.go.

Part 2 — scripts/fetch-feedback.py: Pure stdlib Python script (no external deps, uses urllib). Reads PROD_HOST, API_SESSION_ID, TRUSTED_USERS from env vars or .env file (env vars take priority). Calls GET /api/admin/feedback?status=new&limit=50&after=<cursor> with Authorization: Bearer <API_SESSION_ID> header. When TRUSTED_USERS is set, filters results to only those user_ids (excludes anonymous). Tracks last-fetched timestamp in .feedback-cursor (gitignored). Writes new items to FEEDBACK.md in format: * [type] Rating: N/5 - "message" (date, page: /path). Exit codes: 0=new feedback found, 1=none, 2=error. Detects 401 and prints clear re-auth message.

Part 3 — Env and gitignore: Add PROD_HOST, API_SESSION_ID, TRUSTED_USERS to .env.example. Add .feedback-cursor to .gitignore. Add TRUSTED_USERS to CLAUDE.md env var table.

Verification: Ralph must run python3 scripts/fetch-feedback.py --help and confirm it prints usage info.
done_when: 1) GET /api/admin/feedback endpoint returns feedback JSON with status/limit/after params 2) Endpoint requires auth and TRUSTED_USERS membership, returns 403 otherwise 3) go test ./api passes with admin feedback endpoint tests 4) scripts/fetch-feedback.py exists with --help flag 5) Script reads PROD_HOST and API_SESSION_ID from env or .env 6) Script writes FEEDBACK.md in bullet format 7) Script uses .feedback-cursor for incremental fetches 8) Script exits 0/1/2 per spec 9) Script filters by TRUSTED_USERS when set 10) .gitignore updated with .feedback-cursor 11) .env.example updated with PROD_HOST, API_SESSION_ID, TRUSTED_USERS 12) python3 scripts/fetch-feedback.py --help prints usage

description:
Compact oversized files: TASKS.jsonl, docs/API.md, backend/api/websocket.go — These files have grown large and hurt context-window efficiency for Ralph.

TASKS.jsonl (200 lines, 196 done): Remove all entries with status=done. Keep only todo, in_progress, and blocked tasks. This is safe because completed task history is preserved in git.

docs/API.md (1204 lines): Deduplicate content that is already documented in specs/auth.md and specs/interaction-logging.md. API.md should have concise endpoint reference tables (method, path, auth required, rate limit, brief description) with links to the relevant spec files for full request/response details. Remove inline request/response JSON examples that duplicate the specs.

backend/api/websocket.go (979 lines): Split into multiple files by responsibility. Suggested split: websocket.go (connection setup, ServeHTTP, message routing), websocket_audio.go (processAudio, transcribeAudio, audio blob saving), websocket_llm.go (processTranscript, LLM tool execution, buffer trimming), websocket_tts.go (TTS execution, greeting). Each file should be under 500 lines. Keep all functions in the same api package.
done_when: 1) TASKS.jsonl contains only non-done tasks (todo/in_progress/blocked) 2) docs/API.md under 500 lines with endpoint summary tables linking to specs for details 3) backend/api/websocket.go split into 3-4 files, each under 500 lines 4) go test ./... passes 5) No functionality changes — pure compaction/reorganization
